notes.title: Japanese voice over, Linux version and config screen
notes.content:
Escape 2042 is now available for Linux users.
​Japanese voice over is also available for every language!​ 
A settings screen have been added to select gaming options such as full screen, gamepad/keyboard, sound volume.

notes.title: Japanese Voice Over
notes.content:
I just made an update with Japanese Voice Over during the story screen, so that if the kanjis are too small to read then you can at least hear the story.
The voice over can only be heard when you select the Japanese language.
Please tell me if you would like the Japanese voice over to be heard in other languages too.
